implementation_notes: Stage 2 adds export_rows_transform hookspec that receives a list of row dicts. The caller should check if any plugin implements export_rows_transform; if so, pass the batch. Otherwise fall back to calling export_row_transform per-row. This tests whether Stage 1 isolated the transform step cleanly (easy extension) vs hardcoded it (requires surgery).
accepted_solution_notes: Add hookspec export_rows_transform(database, table, rows, export_format). In the caller, check hook implementations: if any implements export_rows_transform, call that. Otherwise loop and call export_row_transform. The batch path should handle pages naturally.
calibration_notes: Frontier hard: model must extend Stage 1 cleanly. If Stage 1 was poorly implemented (transform inline in many places), this requires rewriting. If Stage 1 isolated a transform step, this is straightforward.
